metadata.article_title: Succession of one firm by another firm.

article.title: Succession of one firm by another firm.
article.content:
188Succession of one firm by another firm.

Section 188  ·  Chapter XVI  ·  C.—Changes in constitution, succession and dissolution  ·  page 703 of the Act
Where a firm carrying on a business or profession is succeeded by another firm, and the case is not one covered by section 187, separate assessments shall be made on the predecessor firm and the successor firm in accordance with the provisions of section 170.
